prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE distinct editorial cover image for a native WeChat hair-care journal, portrait 3:4 aspect ratio, 1536 x 2048. One anonymous hand enters only from the side edge of the photograph and gently presses a folded white cotton towel against the lower lengths of the hair; a calm blotting gesture without twisting or pulling.
